personalization_language_policy.inferred_answer_prefix: Based on your answers, you may
personalization_language_policy.package_phrase: This package may address the priorities you shared
rules: Use You stated only when the statement is directly supported by a selected or typed assessment answer.
Use Based on your answers or You may when the system is interpreting several answers.
Never turn an inference into a diagnosis, identity statement or certain claim.
Never say You have trauma, You suffer from, Your body is toxic or You need medical treatment.
Connect every service recommendation to a stated goal, challenge or preference and explain why the service may be enjoyable or helpful.

commercial_rules.rule: Never return internal_cost or overhead_tier in a guest-facing response.
When client_price.status is custom, tbd or unknown, display Custom quote and route to human confirmation.
Express Reset may not automatically include a high-overhead service. High-overhead matches are shown as clearly priced upgrades.
Rapid Reset may propose no more than one high-overhead included service until its final inclusion and margin policy is approved.
Executive Reset is starts-at pricing. Agendas containing more than two high-overhead services, dining or a fixed-cost entertainment/adventure item require a recalculated quote.
Group agendas use group-capable services only. Individual services are optional upgrades and require staffing, capacity and per-person quote confirmation.
Every item must be labeled proposed included, paid upgrade, custom quote or human review; recommendation does not imply inclusion.
